description: Source code implementing precise scalar requantization functions for quantized neural network operations in PyTorch's QNNPACK backend, including multiple variants for unsigned and signed 32-bit and 64-bit inputs.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_requantize_precise__scalar_unsigned32
methods.description: Performs precise scalar requantization for unsigned 32-bit input data, applying scaling, zero point adjustment, clamping, and rounding.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_requantize_precise__scalar_unsigned64
methods.description: Performs precise scalar requantization for unsigned 64-bit input data, with similar scaling and rounding logic.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_requantize_precise__scalar_signed64
methods.description: Performs precise scalar requantization for signed 64-bit input data, including handling of signed multiplication and rounding.
